zh-tw.title: 相似工具｜整體競品與局部參考
zh-tw.subtitle: 標準模式先看整體目的接近的套件；維運模式可再按旅程檢查各項具體做法。這個模板直接整合的工具改列在「檔案地圖」。
zh-tw.primaryLegend: 整體目的相近｜至少涵蓋 5 個 Journey，且近 6 個月有發版
zh-tw.coverageLegend: 完整＝深綠　部分＝淺綠
zh-tw.criterion: 所有工具都須在擷取日前 6 個月內有發版；主要工具至少涵蓋 5 個 Journey，依完全、部分符合數量排序；其他工具至少 1,000 Stars。Journey tag 依 01–10 排列。

en.title: Similar tools | Direct alternatives and focused references
en.subtitle: Standard mode shows projects with a similar overall purpose; Maintenance mode adds concrete comparisons by journey. Tools this template directly integrates are on the File map instead.
en.primaryLegend: Similar overall purpose | covers at least five journeys and released within six months
en.coverageLegend: Full = dark green; partial = light green
en.criterion: All listed tools must have a release within six months. Primary tools cover at least five journeys and sort by full, then partial matches; other tools also need at least 1,000 Stars. Journey tags run from 01 to 10.

zh-tw.title: 工作定義
zh-tw.legend: 只比較需求記在哪裡、單項與群組如何表示、里程碑如何取得開工同意，以及工作變大時何時增加文件

en.title: Work definition
en.legend: Compares where a request is recorded, how individual and grouped work are represented, how a Milestone gains approval to start, and when larger work needs more documentation.

zh-tw.title: AI 規範
zh-tw.legend: 只比較 repo 如何提供 agent 指令、保存跨時段脈絡、隔離平行修改，以及保留人的決策邊界

en.title: AI rules
en.legend: Compares only how repositories instruct agents, preserve context across sessions, isolate parallel changes, and keep human decision boundaries.

zh-tw.title: 驗證／CI
zh-tw.legend: 只比較驗證邏輯放在哪裡、如何縮小本次範圍、怎樣證明完成，以及模板產物由誰驗證

en.title: Verification / CI
en.legend: Compares only where verification logic lives, how each run is scoped, what proves completion, and who verifies generated projects.

zh-tw.title: 程式語言
zh-tw.legend: 只比較如何選擇語言、是否沿用各生態圈原生工具、多語言如何共存，以及設定是否集中可更新

en.title: Programming languages
en.legend: Compares how languages are selected, whether native ecosystem tools remain visible, how multiple languages coexist, and whether configuration stays centralized and updatable.

zh-tw.title: 依賴安全
zh-tw.legend: 只比較套件更新如何進入 PR、安裝時如何固定版本、已公開漏洞何時檢查，以及發版成品如何留下清冊

en.title: Dependency security
en.legend: Compares only how package updates enter a PR, how installs pin versions, when disclosed vulnerabilities are checked, and how releases retain an inventory.

zh-tw.title: PR／合併
zh-tw.legend: 只比較一張 PR 包含多少工作、如何分批進 main、何時可合併，以及基準分支前進後如何同步

en.title: PR / merge
en.legend: Compares how much work one PR contains, how changes are staged into main, what makes a PR merge-ready, and how branches resynchronize after the base advances.

zh-tw.title: 版本／交付
zh-tw.legend: 只比較版本意圖何時提出、精確版本與 CHANGELOG 何時形成、誰建立 tag／Release，以及成品證據如何交給消費者

en.title: Version / delivery
en.legend: Compares when version intent is declared, when the exact version and changelog materialize, who creates the tag and Release, and how artifact evidence reaches consumers.

zh-tw.title: 規則治理
zh-tw.legend: 只比較治理規則放在哪裡、平台能力不足時如何降級，以及暫時例外如何留下責任與復原路徑

en.title: Rules governance
en.legend: Compares where governance policy lives, how enforcement degrades when platform capability is missing, and how temporary exceptions retain ownership and recovery.

zh-tw.title: 模板升級
zh-tw.legend: 只比較工具如何建立新 repo、首次導入既有 repo、套用後續更新，以及衝突由誰處理

en.title: Template upgrades
en.legend: Compares only how tools create repositories, first adopt existing repositories, apply later updates, and assign conflict ownership.

zh-tw.title: 工作定義
zh-tw.heading: Journey 01／最小測試契約
zh-tw.scope: 只驗證 Issue 如何成為可執行工作，以及里程碑是否取得開工同意；PR 合併與里程碑結案分別列在 Journey 06、07。

en.title: Work definition
en.heading: Journey 01 / Minimum test contract
en.scope: Validates how Issues become actionable and how a Milestone gains approval to start. PR merging and Milestone closure belong to Journeys 06 and 07.

zh-tw.title: Issue 工作邊界
zh-tw.description: 標題、類型、assignee、label 與 duplicate 狀態要能收斂。

en.title: Issue work boundary
en.description: Title, type, assignee, labels, and duplicate disposition must converge.

trigger.zh-tw: Issue opened／edited／reopened／closed
trigger.en: Issue opened, edited, reopened, or closed

automationNote.zh-tw: repo-template 額外確認產生出去的 Issue 表單仍符合定義。
automationNote.en: repo-template also confirms that generated Issue forms retain the definition.

zh-tw.title: Spec 契約與 Issue 同步
zh-tw.description: 驗證必要章節、acceptance criteria、穩定 spec id 與同步的冪等行為。

en.title: Spec contract and Issue sync
en.description: Validate required sections, acceptance criteria, stable spec IDs, and idempotent synchronization.

trigger.zh-tw: Spec／同步程式進入 main 或 dev；可手動執行
trigger.en: Spec or sync code enters main or dev; manual dispatch is also allowed

zh-tw.title: 里程碑啟動門檻
zh-tw.description: 生命週期追蹤 Issue 保存同意與反駁；至少一位非提案者同意且沒有未解決反駁才開始。

en.title: Milestone kickoff gate
en.description: One lifecycle Issue records agreement and objections. Work starts only with one non-proposer agreement and no unresolved objection.

automationNote.zh-tw: 既有 milestone-lifecycle Action 尚未驗證留言中的同意與反駁；由 #400 補上共用 validator。
automationNote.en: The existing milestone-lifecycle Action does not yet validate agreement and objections in comments; #400 adds the shared validator.

zh-tw.title: AI 規範
zh-tw.heading: Journey 02／最小驗證契約
zh-tw.scope: 一般 repo 在兩個 PR 階段都驗證 worktree 安全清理；repo-template 另外檢查 AI 規範來源與產出內容。

en.title: AI rules
en.heading: Journey 02 / Minimum verification contract
en.scope: A normal repository validates safe worktree cleanup at both PR stages. repo-template also checks the AI-rule source and generated guidance.

zh-tw.title: AI 規範入口
zh-tw.description: 所有 agent 讀同一份根規範，生成內容只列該 profile 真能執行的命令。

en.title: AI rules entrypoint
en.description: Every agent reads one root policy, and generated content lists only commands the profile can actually run.

zh-tw.title: 平行工作隔離與安全清理
zh-tw.description: 可寫工作各自使用 branch／worktree，清理時不刪除未合併或有修改的目錄。

en.title: Parallel isolation and safe cleanup
en.description: Writable tasks use separate branches and worktrees, and cleanup never removes unmerged or modified directories.

zh-tw.title: 驗證／CI
zh-tw.heading: Journey 03／分階段驗證
zh-tw.scope: 一般 repo 只驗證自己的改動；repo-template 在交付候選額外驗證生成、導入與更新。Action 只呼叫同一份本機程式。

en.title: Verification / CI
en.heading: Journey 03 / Staged verification
en.scope: A normal repository verifies its own change. A repo-template delivery candidate also verifies generation, adoption, and updates. Actions only call the same local programs.

zh-tw.title: 判斷這次要跑多少
zh-tw.description: 開發時自行跑 focused check；CI 依變更路徑與交付階段選 docs、fast 或 full，未知路徑升級為 full。

en.title: Decide how much to run
en.description: Developers run focused checks directly. CI selects docs, fast, or full from changed paths and delivery stage, with unknown paths escalating to full.

trigger.zh-tw: 工作 PR（topic → main 或 dev/m*）
trigger.en: Work PR (topic → main or dev/m*)

trigger.zh-tw: promotion／merge group／hotfix／手動執行
trigger.en: Promotion, merge group, hotfix, or manual dispatch

zh-tw.title: Issue PR 的快速回饋
zh-tw.description: 只跑與本次修改相關的格式、靜態檢查、一般測試與必要 smoke；不跑完整 profile／adopt／update 矩陣。

en.title: Fast feedback for an Issue PR
en.description: Run relevant formatting, static checks, ordinary tests, and necessary smoke checks without the full profile, adoption, or update matrix.

note.zh-tw: template、workflow 或 shell 有變更時，fast 會額外產生一個代表性 repo 做 smoke 驗證。
note.en: When template, workflow, or shell files change, fast also generates one representative repository for a smoke check.

zh-tw.title: 交付候選的完整證據
zh-tw.description: 只對固定且未再變動的交付候選跑一次完整驗證；成功後以 SHA／tree 證明合併的是同一份內容。

en.title: Complete evidence for a delivery candidate
en.description: Run full verification once on a fixed, unchanged candidate, then bind the merge to the same SHA and tree.

note.zh-tw: 額外驗證模板本身、生成結果，以及既有 repo 的導入與更新路徑；每個 `scripts/verify-stage-*` 都能單獨重跑一個階段，`scripts/verify-template.sh` 仍是唯一必要的最終聚合入口。
note.en: Additionally verifies the template, generated output, and existing-repository adoption and update paths; each scripts/verify-stage-* script can rerun one stage on its own, while scripts/verify-template.sh remains the one required final aggregate entry point.

zh-tw.title: 程式語言
zh-tw.heading: Journey 04／語言模組
zh-tw.scope: 建立或導入時選擇語言；Issue PR 只跑所選模組，交付 PR 再完成建置與打包。所有入口都讀取同一份公版設定。

en.title: Programming languages
en.heading: Journey 04 / Language modules
en.scope: Languages are selected during creation or adoption. Issue PRs run the selected modules, while release PRs add builds and packaging. Every entrypoint reads the same template configuration.

zh-tw.title: 設定與實際檔案一致
zh-tw.description: 公版設定列出的語言必須和 repo 內的 Python、Rust、TypeScript 專案檔一致。

en.title: Configuration matches repository files
en.description: Languages listed by the template configuration must match the Python, Rust, and TypeScript project files in the repository.

trigger.zh-tw: 修改程式、套件或公版設定的 Issue PR
trigger.en: Issue PR changing code, dependencies, or template settings

note.zh-tw: 確認 Copier 建立單一設定檔，並正確組合各語言模組。
note.en: Confirms that Copier creates one configuration file and composes the selected language modules correctly.

zh-tw.title: 各語言使用自己的檢查
zh-tw.description: Python、Rust、TypeScript 各自執行格式、靜態檢查、測試與必要的建置；共通規則只跑一次。

en.title: Each language runs its native checks
en.description: Python, Rust, and TypeScript each run their own formatting, static checks, tests, and required builds while shared rules run once.

note.zh-tw: 另外建立各語言與多選範例，確認生成、更新與鎖檔仍可使用。
note.en: Additionally creates single- and multi-language fixtures to confirm generation, updates, and lockfiles remain usable.

zh-tw.title: 依賴安全
zh-tw.heading: Journey 05／依賴安全
zh-tw.scope: 依賴異動先重現鎖檔安裝；已知漏洞只在依賴變更與交付候選加跑，週期掃描另補沒有 PR 的時段。

en.title: Dependency security
en.heading: Journey 05 / Dependency security
en.scope: Dependency changes first reproduce the locked install. Vulnerability checks run for dependency changes and delivery candidates, while a schedule covers periods without PRs.

zh-tw.title: 鎖定版本可重現安裝
zh-tw.description: 依 lockfile 安裝，拒絕未記錄的解析結果；TypeScript 另執行三天觀察期與發布者 trust policy。

en.title: Reproduce the locked dependency set
en.description: Install from the lockfile and reject unrecorded resolution. TypeScript also enforces a three-day observation window and publisher trust policy.

trigger.zh-tw: 依賴檔案變更的 Issue PR
trigger.en: Issue PR changing dependency files

trigger.zh-tw: 交付 PR／merge group／手動完整驗證
trigger.en: Delivery PR, merge group, or manual full verification

note.zh-tw: 依賴設定變更時，額外產生一個代表性 repo 驗證生成結果。
note.en: A dependency-setting change also generates one representative repository to verify the rendered result.

note.zh-tw: 完整測試所有 profile 的生成與鎖檔契約。
note.en: Fully tests generated profiles and their lockfile contract.

zh-tw.title: 一般更新自動提出 PR
zh-tw.description: Dependabot 依生態圈分組更新，一般新版等三天；安全修補不套用等待期。

en.title: Open routine update PRs
en.description: Dependabot groups updates by ecosystem and waits three days for ordinary releases without delaying security fixes.

automationNote.zh-tw: 每週依生態圈提出更新 PR；建立的 PR 仍走同一個 CI job。
automationNote.en: Opens weekly update PRs by ecosystem; generated PRs still use the same CI job.

note.zh-tw: 確認不同 profile 只生成適用的更新生態圈。
note.en: Confirms that each profile emits only its applicable update ecosystems.

zh-tw.title: 已公開漏洞立即檢查
zh-tw.description: 依賴檔案變更與交付候選使用同一個 OSV 本機入口；每週排程補上沒有 PR 的期間。

en.title: Check disclosed vulnerabilities immediately
en.description: Dependency changes and delivery candidates share one local OSV entrypoint; a weekly schedule covers periods without PRs.

trigger.zh-tw: 依賴檔案變更的 Issue PR
trigger.en: Issue PR changing dependency files

trigger.zh-tw: 交付 PR／merge group／手動完整驗證
trigger.en: Delivery PR, merge group, or manual full verification

trigger.zh-tw: 每週一／手動掃描
trigger.en: Weekly Monday or manual scan

automationNote.zh-tw: 每週與手動掃描另由薄 workflow 呼叫同一入口，不複製掃描邏輯。
automationNote.en: A thin weekly and manual workflow calls the same entrypoint without duplicating scanning logic.

zh-tw.title: 發版成品清冊與雜湊
zh-tw.description: 從精確 tag 的真正成品建立 SPDX SBOM、checksum 與相互綁定的證據。

en.title: Release inventory and digests
en.description: Build an SPDX SBOM, checksums, and mutually bound evidence from the real artifacts at the exact tag.

automationNote.zh-tw: 依賴安全擁有 SBOM 規格與驗證；真正成品出現時由發版流程觸發，但不把責任移到「版本／交付」。
automationNote.en: Dependency security owns the SBOM contract and validation. The release flow triggers it when real artifacts exist without taking ownership of the rule.

zh-tw.title: PR／合併
zh-tw.heading: Journey 06／兩階段 PR
zh-tw.scope: 工作 PR 先驗證單一 Issue 與目的分支；交付 PR 再驗證完整批次。合併授權由規則治理統一處理。

en.title: PR / merge
en.heading: Journey 06 / Two PR stages
en.scope: A work PR first validates one Issue and its destination; a release PR then validates the complete batch. Rules governance owns merge authorization.

zh-tw.title: PR 資料與目的分支
zh-tw.description: 標題、Issue、label、里程碑與目的分支必須互相一致。

en.title: PR metadata and destination
en.description: Title, Issue, label, Milestone, and destination branch must agree.

trigger.zh-tw: PR 開啟、內容／commit／metadata 變更
trigger.en: PR opened or its content, commits, or metadata changes

note.zh-tw: 使用相同 validator；repo-template 不維護另一套 PR 規則。
note.en: Uses the same validator; repo-template has no second PR policy.

zh-tw.title: 候選內容包含最新基準
zh-tw.description: 工作 PR 必須沿可追溯的 dev 鏈回到 main；同步 PR 只能把精確的 main 更新帶回目標 dev。

en.title: Candidate contains the current base
en.description: A work PR must trace through its dev chain to main; a sync PR may carry only the exact main update back to its target dev branch.

trigger.zh-tw: 每次工作 PR 與 sync PR 更新
trigger.en: Every work-PR and sync-PR update

note.zh-tw: 交付 PR 建立與 main 前進後的必要跨分支同步仍是人工 PR；#430 判定不恢復後已移除舊 workflows。
note.en: Delivery-PR creation and required cross-branch synchronization after main advances remain manual PRs; #430 removed the old workflows after deciding not to restore them.

zh-tw.title: 工作 PR 合併後結束 Issue
zh-tw.description: 工作 PR 成功進入正確目的分支後，才結束同號 Issue；交付 PR 不重複關單。

en.title: Close the Issue after its work PR merges
en.description: Close the matching Issue only after its work PR enters the correct dev branch. The release PR does not close it again.

trigger.zh-tw: 里程碑工作 PR 合併進 dev/m*
trigger.en: Milestone work PR merged into dev/m*

note.zh-tw: 直接進 main 的一般工作與 Hotfix 沿用 GitHub 原生關單，不啟動這支 Action。
note.en: Standalone work and hotfixes merged directly to main retain GitHub-native closure and do not start this Action.

note.zh-tw: 使用相同關單程式；repo-template 不維護另一套規則。
note.en: Uses the same closure program; repo-template has no second rule.

zh-tw.title: 版本／交付
zh-tw.heading: Journey 07／交付與結案
zh-tw.scope: 交付完成並留下證據後才結束里程碑；若本批需要發版，還要附上 Release evidence。提前終止則先處理未完成工作。

en.title: Version / delivery
en.heading: Journey 07 / Delivery and closure
en.scope: A Milestone closes only after delivery records its evidence; a batch that requires a release also records Release evidence. Early termination first disposes of unfinished work.

zh-tw.title: 獨立工作直接交付
zh-tw.description: 沒有里程碑的單一工作 PR 直接進 main；一般 review 與風險分級驗證通過後，由 Closes #N 結案。

en.title: Deliver standalone work directly
en.description: A single work PR without a Milestone targets main; after normal review and risk-based verification, Closes #N completes the Issue.

trigger.zh-tw: 無里程碑的 topic PR → main
trigger.en: Topic PR without a Milestone → main

trigger.zh-tw: 同一 PR；依內容選 docs／fast／full
trigger.en: The same PR; selects docs, fast, or full by content

note.zh-tw: 合併先完成 repository delivery；release workflow 再判斷是否需要版本 PR，不把兩個動作混成一次。
note.en: Merge first completes repository delivery; the release workflow then decides whether a version PR is needed instead of combining both actions.

note.zh-tw: root 與生成專案使用同一條 route 與 validator。
note.en: The root and generated projects use the same route and validator.

zh-tw.title: Hotfix 完整驗證與證據
zh-tw.description: 緊急修正仍須 Bug Issue、review 與 full；合併後保存 head SHA、run、rollback 與發版決策。

en.title: Fully verify and evidence a hotfix
en.description: An urgent fix still needs a Bug Issue, review, and full verification; after merge it retains the head SHA, run, rollback note, and release decision.

trigger.zh-tw: bug＋hotfix 的 fix/* PR → main
trigger.en: bug + hotfix on a fix/* PR → main

trigger.zh-tw: 同一 hotfix PR；固定 full
trigger.en: The same hotfix PR; always full

note.zh-tw: fix 預設是 patch 意圖；Release Please 產生精確版本 PR，仍須人審查後才發布。
note.en: fix declares patch intent by default; Release Please creates the exact version PR, which still requires human review before publication.

note.zh-tw: root 與生成專案使用同一條 route 與 validator。
note.en: The root and generated projects use the same route and validator.

zh-tw.title: 版本與 Release ownership
zh-tw.description: PR 只宣告 SemVer 意圖；Release Please 集中更新精確版本與 CHANGELOG，單一 workflow 負責 tag 與 GitHub Release。

en.title: Version and Release ownership
en.description: A PR declares only SemVer intent. Release Please centralizes the exact version and changelog, while one workflow owns the tag and GitHub Release.

automationNote.zh-tw: root 與新 repo 由 Release Please 建版本 PR；既有 repo 保留 product-owned workflow。
automationNote.en: Release Please opens version PRs for the root and new repositories; adopted repositories retain their product-owned workflow.

trigger.zh-tw: main 前進或人工重跑
trigger.en: main advances or a manual rerun

zh-tw.title: 版本候選與發布證據
zh-tw.description: 同一 workflow 驗證 bot 版本 PR 的精確 SHA；合併後以 draft、下載重驗與 immutable check 完成發布。

en.title: Version candidate and release evidence
en.description: The same workflow validates the bot version PR's exact SHA; after merge, draft staging, download verification, and the immutable check complete publication.

zh-tw.title: 里程碑結案
zh-tw.description: 正常完成時確認發版與交付證據；提前終止時先記錄原因，並移轉或取消未完成 Issue。

en.title: Milestone closure
en.description: Normal completion confirms release and delivery evidence. Early termination records a reason and first moves or cancels unfinished Issues.

trigger.zh-tw: 生命週期追蹤 Issue closed／reopened／milestoned
trigger.en: Lifecycle Issue closed, reopened, or milestoned

note.zh-tw: 使用相同結案程式；repo-template 不維護另一套里程碑規則。
note.en: Uses the same closure program; repo-template has no second Milestone rule.

zh-tw.title: 規則治理
zh-tw.heading: Journey 08／審查與設定漂移
zh-tw.scope: 每張 PR 只自動請一位非作者 reviewer；選配排程重用本機檢查，不能把通知誤稱為合併門禁。

en.title: Rules governance
en.heading: Journey 08 / Review and settings drift
en.scope: Each PR requests one non-author reviewer. The optional schedule reuses the local check and is never described as a merge gate.

zh-tw.title: 輪派審查人
zh-tw.description: 只讀取 base branch 的 REVIEWERS，排除 PR 作者後提出一位個別 review request。

en.title: Assign a reviewer
en.description: Read REVIEWERS only from the base branch, exclude the PR author, and request one individual review.

trigger.zh-tw: PR 開啟、重開或轉為 ready
trigger.en: PR opened, reopened, or marked ready

zh-tw.title: 偵測治理設定漂移
zh-tw.description: 比較 repo 現況與政策；可修正差異會更新一張 Issue，方案限制只留下 DEGRADED 證據。

en.title: Detect governance drift
en.description: Compare live repository settings with policy. Fixable drift updates one Issue, while plan limits retain DEGRADED evidence.

trigger.zh-tw: enable_governance_drift_check 開啟後，每日或手動
trigger.en: Daily or manual when enable_governance_drift_check is on

note.zh-tw: source repo 保留同一支程式供下發與本機驗證，但目前不啟用自己的排程。
note.en: The source repository retains the same program for generation and local verification but does not enable its own schedule.

zh-tw.title: 模板升級
zh-tw.heading: Journey 09／建立、導入與更新
zh-tw.scope: 公版 repo 驗證建立、既有 repo 首次導入與後續更新；生成 repo 只保留自己的驗證入口與選用的更新通知。首次導入沒有可信任 base 時由人核准，不執行 PR head 新增的程式。

en.title: Template upgrades
en.heading: Journey 09 / Create, adopt, and update
en.scope: The template repository verifies creation, first adoption, and later updates. Generated repositories keep only their own verification entrypoint and optional update notice. A person approves a first adoption whose base has no trusted verifier; PR-head programs are not executed.

zh-tw.title: 建立新 repo
zh-tw.description: 由固定公版版本產生所選設定與語言模組，再執行生成 repo 自己的驗證。

en.title: Create a new repository
en.description: Generate the selected settings and language modules from a pinned template revision, then run the generated repository's own verification.

note.zh-tw: 生成完成後只執行自己的驗證；不下發公版專用測試。
note.en: After creation, the generated repository runs only its own verification; template-only tests are not delivered.

note.zh-tw: 建立一個代表性 repo 做 smoke；不在每張 Issue PR 跑完整矩陣。
note.en: Creates one representative repository for a smoke check without running the complete matrix on every Issue PR.

note.zh-tw: 完整重跑建立矩陣。
note.en: Reruns the complete creation matrix.

zh-tw.title: 首次導入既有 repo
zh-tw.description: repo 外的固定 CLI 產生 machine plan 並套用同一份 plan；第一張 PR 由人核對來源、diff 與本機證據。

en.title: First adoption of an existing repository
en.description: A pinned CLI outside the repository creates a machine plan and applies that same plan. A person reviews the source, diff, and local evidence in the first PR.

automationNote.zh-tw: 人工門檻：base 尚無可信任 verifier 時不執行 PR head 程式；合併後才啟用一般自動檢查。
automationNote.en: Manual gate: when the base has no trusted verifier, no PR-head program runs. Normal automation starts after merge.

note.zh-tw: 修改導入邏輯時在本機跑受影響的 focused case；大型導入矩陣不放進 fast。
note.en: Changes to adoption logic run the affected focused case locally; the large adoption matrix stays out of fast.

note.zh-tw: 完整重跑導入、人工衝突與失敗不改 target。
note.en: Fully reruns adoption, manual conflicts, and leaving the target untouched on failure.

zh-tw.title: 後續更新與衝突
zh-tw.description: 先在 candidate 完成 Copier update 與驗證；通過後才修改 target，失敗或衝突可修正後重跑。

en.title: Later updates and conflicts
en.description: Complete the Copier update and verification in a candidate first. Change the target only after success; failures and conflicts can be corrected and rerun.

trigger.zh-tw: 首次導入已合併後的更新 Issue PR
trigger.en: Update Issue PRs after the first adoption has merged

automationNote.zh-tw: base 上的 PR policy 先驗證規則，唯讀 CI 再執行候選內容。
automationNote.en: The PR policy from the base validates rules first, then read-only CI runs the candidate.

trigger.zh-tw: 含模板更新的發版 PR
trigger.en: Release PRs containing a template update

automationNote.zh-tw: 沿用唯讀 contents 權限的 CI；Action 只選擇並呼叫 repo-local 驗證。
automationNote.en: Uses CI with read-only contents permission; the Action only selects and calls repository-local verification.

note.zh-tw: 修改更新邏輯時在本機跑受影響的 focused case；大型 update 矩陣不放進 fast。
note.en: Changes to update logic run the affected focused case locally; the large update matrix stays out of fast.

note.zh-tw: 完整驗證同一 repo 的 update、legacy conflict 與原子失敗。
note.en: Fully verifies updates on the same repository, legacy conflicts, and atomic failure.

zh-tw.title: 通知有新版公版
zh-tw.description: 通知只提示維護者評估新版，不會自動套用或合併。

en.title: Notify maintainers about a new template
en.description: A notification only asks maintainers to evaluate a new revision; it never applies or merges one automatically.

trigger.zh-tw: 每週一／手動執行；只有設定開啟才產生
trigger.en: Every Monday or manual dispatch; generated only when enabled

note.zh-tw: 確認開啟時 workflow 與 checker 同時產生，關閉時兩者都不存在，而且 root 不會誤執行。
note.en: Confirms that the workflow and checker are both generated when enabled, both absent when disabled, and never run in the template root.

description.zh-tw: 比較需求、完成條件與長期決策分別保存在哪裡，以及從哪份資料開始工作。
description.en: Compares where requests, completion conditions, and long-lived decisions are kept and which record starts the work.

csarc.zh-tw: GitHub Issue 是每項工作的入口；核准的 spec／ADR 只保存需要長期維持的決策，不以聊天紀錄或未提交內容取代 Issue。
csarc.en: A GitHub Issue is the entrypoint for each work item. Approved specs and ADRs retain only durable decisions; chat transcripts and uncommitted material do not replace the Issue.

title.en: How individual and grouped work are represented

description.zh-tw: 比較工作類別、Parent／Sub-issue、Dependency 與里程碑各自表達什麼關係。
description.en: Compares what work types, parent and sub-issues, dependencies, and Milestones each represent.

csarc.zh-tw: Feature／Task／Bug 表示工作性質；Parent／Sub-issue 表示成果拆分；Dependency 表示先後阻擋；里程碑只集合有共同目標、期限或交付批次的 Issue。
csarc.en: Feature, Task, and Bug express the nature of work. Parent and sub-issues express decomposition, Dependency expresses blocking order, and a Milestone only groups Issues sharing an outcome, deadline, or delivery batch.

title.zh-tw: 里程碑如何取得開工同意
title.en: How a Milestone gains approval to start

description.zh-tw: 比較批次開始前如何取得同意，以及尚未解決的反駁如何阻擋開工。
description.en: Compares how a batch gains approval before work starts and how unresolved objections block kickoff.

csarc.zh-tw: 每個里程碑配一張生命週期追蹤 Issue；至少一位非提案者同意且沒有尚未解決的反駁才開始。
csarc.en: Each Milestone has one lifecycle tracking Issue. Work starts only after at least one non-proposer agrees and no objection remains unresolved.

title.zh-tw: 定義如何變成 repo 狀態

description.zh-tw: 比較人直接改檔、由設定產生檔案，或由服務持續修正遠端狀態。
description.en: Compares direct file edits, generated files, and services that continuously reconcile remote state.

csarc.zh-tw: copier.yml、template/ 與 profiles/catalog.yaml 宣告生成基線；同一份 .csarc/config.yml 保存 repo 選項，配對檔由 root 產生 template 副本，產品檔仍由下游 repo 持有。
csarc.en: copier.yml, template/, and profiles/catalog.yaml define the generated baseline. One .csarc/config.yml stores repository choices, paired files are generated from root into template, and downstream repositories retain product-owned files.

title.zh-tw: 建立、導入與更新如何銜接
title.en: How creation, adoption, and updates connect

description.zh-tw: 比較新 repo 如何建立、既有 repo 如何首次導入、後續版本如何更新，以及衝突由誰處理。
description.en: Compares how new repositories are created, existing repositories are first adopted, later revisions are applied, and conflicts are resolved.

csarc.zh-tw: Copier 建立新 repo；既有 repo 由固定版本 CLI 在本機產生外部 plan，人工核准首次 PR。合併後由 base 上的 PR policy 與唯讀 CI 驗證後續更新；更新候選先完整驗證，失敗或衝突不修改 target。
csarc.en: Copier creates new repositories. A pinned CLI creates an external local plan for an existing repository and a person approves its first PR. After merge, the PR policy from the base and read-only CI validate later updates. An update candidate is fully verified before target files change, so failure or conflict leaves the target untouched.

title.zh-tw: 進行中變更如何成為正式

description.zh-tw: 比較 branch、change 或設定 PR 在何時完成審查、合併與歸檔。
description.en: Compares when a branch, change, or configuration PR is reviewed, merged, and archived.

csarc.zh-tw: 工作 PR 以 Closes #<issue> 連回範圍並結束單項工作；交付 PR 再把已驗證批次送進 main。發版若有需要，另由版本／交付 owner 建立。
csarc.en: A work PR links its scope with Closes #<issue> and completes that work. A delivery PR then carries the verified batch into main; the version and delivery owner creates a Release separately when needed.

title.zh-tw: 小改與大型工作如何分流
title.en: How small and large changes diverge

description.zh-tw: 比較何時可以直接修改，何時必須增加 spec、plan、tasks 或架構文件。
description.en: Compares when a direct edit is sufficient and when a spec, plan, tasks, or architecture record is required.

csarc.zh-tw: 小型 bounded change 只用 Issue 與針對性驗證；跨 session、高風險或長期契約才增加 spec、ADR 或 plan。
csarc.en: A small bounded change uses an Issue and focused verification. Work spanning sessions, carrying high risk, or defining a durable contract adds a spec, ADR, or plan.

description.zh-tw: 比較規則使用單一 repo 檔案、依工具轉換，或由外部框架注入。
description.en: Compares a single repository file, tool-specific rule conversion, and instructions injected by an external framework.

csarc.zh-tw: 根目錄 AGENTS.md 是唯一來源；CLAUDE.md 只薄匯入，子目錄只有規則真的不同時才覆寫。
csarc.en: The root AGENTS.md is the single source. CLAUDE.md is a thin import, and child files exist only for genuine scoped differences.

description.zh-tw: 比較 Issue、spec、plan 或任務檔如何保留已確認的決策與未完成工作。
description.en: Compares how Issues, specs, plans, or task files retain confirmed decisions and unfinished work.

csarc.zh-tw: Issue／PR 記進度，核准的 spec／ADR 記長期決策；只有跨 session、高風險或難復原工作才增加 plan。
csarc.en: Issues and PRs track progress, while approved specs and ADRs retain long-lived decisions. A plan is added only for cross-session, high-risk, or hard-to-recover work.

description.zh-tw: 比較共用目錄、分支／worktree 與 agent 調度器如何避免修改互撞。
description.en: Compares shared directories, branches and worktrees, and agent orchestrators for preventing colliding changes.

csarc.zh-tw: 每項可寫工作各用 branch／worktree，只平行處理互不依賴的範圍；唯讀工作不必建立新 worktree。
csarc.en: Each writable task gets its own branch and worktree, and only independent scopes run in parallel. Read-only work needs no new worktree.

description.zh-tw: 比較需求取捨、外部影響、不可逆操作與合併授權由誰負責。
description.en: Compares who owns requirement trade-offs, external effects, irreversible operations, and merge authorization.

csarc.zh-tw: 人負責需求、重大取捨、外部影響與不可逆操作；「規則治理」定義審查、合併資格與例外。
csarc.en: People own requirements, material trade-offs, external effects, and irreversible operations. Rules governance defines review, merge eligibility, and exceptions.

title.zh-tw: 本機與 CI 共用什麼
title.en: What local and CI runs share

description.zh-tw: 比較驗證邏輯是可在本機重跑的程式、CI 專用 YAML，或另一套 pipeline runtime。
description.en: Compares whether verification lives in locally runnable programs, CI-only YAML, or another pipeline runtime.

csarc.zh-tw: 測試邏輯放在 scripts／tests；本機直接執行，Action 只設定事件、權限與呼叫同一入口，不複製判斷。
csarc.en: Verification logic lives in scripts and tests. Local runs execute it directly, while Actions only provide events, permissions, and a call to the same entrypoint.

title.zh-tw: 怎麼縮小本次驗證範圍

description.zh-tw: 比較每次全跑、依 dependency graph 選 affected tasks，或依變更路徑與交付階段分級。
description.en: Compares running everything, selecting affected tasks from a dependency graph, and routing by changed path plus delivery stage.

csarc.zh-tw: 系統依修改內容與交付階段選 docs／fast／full；Issue PR 走 fast，promotion、hotfix、merge queue 與未知路徑走 full。
csarc.en: The system selects docs, fast, or full from the change and delivery stage. Issue PRs use fast; promotions, hotfixes, merge queues, and unknown paths use full.

description.zh-tw: 比較只看舊結果、要求當次完整輸出，或把證據綁到精確 commit／candidate。
description.en: Compares relying on old results, requiring fresh complete output, and binding evidence to an exact commit or candidate.

csarc.zh-tw: 完成宣稱必須有當次指令與結果；合併證據綁定精確 PR HEAD，promotion 再核對 candidate tree，零步數帳務阻擋不算測試成功。
csarc.en: Completion claims require fresh command output. Merge evidence binds to the exact PR head, promotion also checks the candidate tree, and a zero-step billing block is not test success.

description.zh-tw: 比較只測產生器、測輸出快照，或真的建立／導入／更新候選 repo 再執行驗證。
description.en: Compares testing only the generator, snapshotting output, and creating, adopting, or updating candidate repositories before running their checks.

csarc.zh-tw: 一般 repo 只測自己的產品；repo-template 的 full 入口執行完整 pytest，實際涵蓋 Python／Rust／TypeScript 的生成與既有 repo 導入，不維護整棵輸出的 snapshot。
csarc.en: A normal repository tests only its product. The repo-template full entrypoint runs the complete pytest suite, covering Python, Rust, and TypeScript generation plus existing-repository adoption without maintaining whole-tree snapshots.

title.zh-tw: 建立時如何選擇程式語言
title.en: How languages are selected at creation

description.zh-tw: 比較固定專案類型、可複選語言模組，以及完全交由使用者事後設定。
description.en: Compares fixed project types, independently selectable language modules, and leaving all setup to users after creation.

csarc.zh-tw: 建立或導入時可獨立選擇 Python、Rust、TypeScript；沒有選取的語言不產生相關檔案或 CI 步驟。
csarc.en: Creation and adoption select Python, Rust, and TypeScript independently. Unselected languages produce neither files nor CI steps.

description.zh-tw: 比較共用抽象工具與各生態圈原生的格式、型別、測試、建置及打包工具。
description.en: Compares one abstract tool with each ecosystem's native formatting, type, test, build, and packaging tools.

csarc.zh-tw: Python 使用 uv、Ruff、ty、pytest 與 wheel；Rust 使用 rustfmt、Clippy、cargo test、release build 與 Cargo package；TypeScript 使用 Biome、TypeScript、Vitest 與 npm package。
csarc.en: Python uses uv, Ruff, ty, pytest, and wheel; Rust uses rustfmt, Clippy, cargo test, release builds, and Cargo package; TypeScript uses Biome, TypeScript, Vitest, and npm package.

description.zh-tw: 比較每個組合另做一套流程，以及把可重用的單語言模組合併執行。
description.en: Compares separate workflows for every combination with composing reusable single-language modules.

csarc.zh-tw: 每種語言只定義一次；多選時合併所選模組，共通的工作規則、文件、機密與依賴檢查只跑一次。
csarc.en: Each language is defined once. Multi-language repositories combine selected modules while shared work-rule, documentation, secret, and dependency checks run once.

title.zh-tw: 語言設定如何保存與更新
title.en: How language settings are stored and updated

description.zh-tw: 比較散落在各工具檔案、獨立 profile，與一份可追蹤模板來源的 repo 設定。
description.en: Compares settings scattered across tool files, a separate profile, and one repository configuration that also tracks its template source.

csarc.zh-tw: `.csarc/config.yml` 同時是 Copier answers file 與公版設定；所有入口讀同一份資料，調整時由 `csarc update` 同步設定與生成檔。
csarc.en: `.csarc/config.yml` is both the Copier answers file and template configuration. Every entrypoint reads it, and `csarc update` changes the setting together with generated files.

title.zh-tw: 套件更新如何進入 PR
title.en: How package updates enter a PR

description.zh-tw: 比較定期 PR、中央分組與人工升版。
description.en: Compares scheduled PRs, central grouping, and manual upgrades.

csarc.zh-tw: Dependabot 依生態圈每週分組提出 PR；一般更新等三天，安全更新不等。
csarc.en: Dependabot opens weekly PRs grouped by ecosystem; ordinary updates wait three days and security updates do not.

title.en: How installs pin the package set

description.zh-tw: 比較最新版、lockfile 與 resolver 限制。
description.en: Compares latest versions, lockfiles, and resolver policies.

csarc.zh-tw: Python、Rust、TypeScript 都依 lockfile 安裝；pnpm 另拒絕未滿三天或 publisher trust 降級的版本。本機與 CI 都執行。
csarc.en: Python, Rust, and TypeScript install from lockfiles. pnpm also rejects releases younger than three days or publisher-trust downgrades. Local and CI runs both enforce it.

description.zh-tw: 比較更新通知、PR 檢查與週期掃描。
description.en: Compares update notifications, PR checks, and scheduled scans.

csarc.zh-tw: OSV 是單一資料入口；依賴 PR、交付候選與每週／手動排程共用本機程式。
csarc.en: OSV is the single data source. Dependency PRs, delivery candidates, and weekly or manual schedules share one local program.

title.zh-tw: 發版成品如何留下清冊
title.en: How a release retains an artifact inventory

description.zh-tw: 比較原始碼推測、真正成品掃描與平台套件清單。
description.en: Compares source inference, real-artifact scans, and platform package lists.

csarc.zh-tw: Syft 掃精確 tag 成品；程式再綁定 SPDX 2.3、checksum、來源與 provenance。規格與測試已存在。
csarc.en: Syft scans exact-tag artifacts; repository code binds SPDX 2.3, checksums, source, and provenance. The contract and tests exist.

title.zh-tw: 一張 PR 包含多少工作
title.en: How much work belongs in one PR

description.zh-tw: 比較一張 PR 對應單一可驗收工作、相依 PR 堆疊，或一次提交整批變更。
description.en: Compares one independently acceptable change per PR, a stack of dependent PRs, and one PR carrying a complete batch.

csarc.zh-tw: Issue PR 對應一張仍開啟、完成條件已勾選的 Issue；新增範圍另開 Issue，里程碑只代表交付批次。
csarc.en: A work PR maps to one open Issue whose acceptance checklist is complete. Added scope receives another Issue, while a Milestone represents only the delivery batch.

title.en: How work is staged into main

description.zh-tw: 比較每張 PR 直接進 main、先進長期整合分支，或以短期堆疊維持相依順序。
description.en: Compares merging every PR directly into main, staging work on a long-lived integration branch, and preserving dependencies in a short-lived stack.

csarc.zh-tw: 能獨立驗收、沒有共同期限或跨 Issue 相依的工作直接進 main；需要共同整合、整批驗收或 canary 時才改掛 Milestone 並進對應 dev/m*。
csarc.en: Work that can be accepted independently and has no shared deadline or cross-Issue dependency goes directly to main. Shared integration, batch acceptance, or canary needs require a Milestone and its matching dev/m* branch.

description.zh-tw: 比較只靠人工判斷、依 checks／review 合併，或由 merge queue 以最新基準重驗。
description.en: Compares human judgment alone, checks and reviews, and merge queues that retest against the latest base.

csarc.zh-tw: PR policy 與 CI 先產生證據；合併工具再把授權與檢查綁到精確 head SHA。Free private 目前沒有可強制的 Ruleset，因此仍需人工遵守。
csarc.en: PR policy and CI produce evidence before the merge tool binds checks and authorization to the exact head SHA. The current Free private repository has no enforceable Ruleset, so maintainers must still follow the policy manually.

title.en: How branches resynchronize after the base advances

description.zh-tw: 比較直接 push、rebase／stack restack，以及用可審查的同步 PR 處理衝突。
description.en: Compares direct pushes, rebasing or restacking, and reviewable synchronization PRs for resolving conflicts.

csarc.zh-tw: main 前進後，以 sync/main-to-* PR 更新仍在開發的 dev 分支；衝突由該分支 owner 解決，不 force-push 或直接改寫目標分支。
csarc.en: After main advances, a sync/main-to-* PR updates each active dev branch. Its owner resolves conflicts without force-pushing or writing directly to the destination branch.

description.zh-tw: 比較由 PR／commit 慣例推導、由 changeset 檔明列，或在發版時人工決定。
description.en: Compares deriving impact from PR or commit conventions, declaring it in changeset files, and deciding manually at release time.

csarc.zh-tw: PR title 只宣告 major／minor／patch／no-release 意圖；不在工作 PR 預約精確版本。
csarc.en: The PR title declares only major, minor, patch, or no-release intent; a work PR never reserves an exact version.

title.zh-tw: 何時形成精確版本與 CHANGELOG
title.en: When the exact version and changelog materialize

description.zh-tw: 比較可審查的版本 PR、成功 CI 後全自動配置，以及人工一次同步所有版本面。
description.en: Compares a reviewable version PR, fully automatic materialization after CI, and one manual change that synchronizes every version surface.

csarc.zh-tw: Release Please 建立一張可審查的版本 PR，同步 manifest、package metadata、CHANGELOG 與 marker；CI checkout 不暫時改版本。
csarc.en: Release Please opens one reviewable version PR that synchronizes the manifest, package metadata, changelog, and markers; CI does not make a temporary version edit.

title.zh-tw: 誰建立 tag 與 GitHub Release
title.en: Who creates the tag and GitHub Release

description.zh-tw: 比較工具自動擁有整條發版、版本 PR 合併後建立 Release、維護分支如何發布修補，以及產品自行持有發布流程。
description.en: Compares a tool owning the whole release, creating a Release after a version PR merges, publishing fixes from maintenance branches, and product-owned publishing.

csarc.zh-tw: Hotfix 仍先經 Bug Issue、review 與 full verification 進 main；Release Please 再建立 patch 版本 PR，合併後由單一 workflow 發布。
csarc.en: A hotfix still reaches main through a Bug Issue, review, and full verification; Release Please then opens the patch version PR and one workflow publishes after merge.

title.zh-tw: 使用者怎麼驗證發版成品

description.zh-tw: 比較只提供 release notes，以及另外綁定 checksum、SBOM、來源與 attestation。
description.en: Compares release notes alone with binding checksums, an SBOM, source identity, and attestations.

csarc.zh-tw: GitHub Release 會附 exact-tag source、語言成品、SHA-256、SPDX 2.3 與來源證據，並在公開後確認 immutable；attestation 與 consumption 仍是選配。
csarc.en: Each GitHub Release includes exact-tag source, language packages, SHA-256, SPDX 2.3, and source evidence, then confirms immutability after publication; attestations and consumption remain optional.

description.zh-tw: 比較 repo 內宣告、產生器設定與中央平台政策，並區分期望狀態和 GitHub 實際狀態。
description.en: Compares repository declarations, generator configuration, and central policy while separating desired state from live GitHub state.

csarc.zh-tw: `.csarc/config.yml` 保存高價值選項，`policies/` 保存低頻 GitHub 期望狀態；`plan`／`apply`／`check` 再核對 live repository。
csarc.en: `.csarc/config.yml` holds high-value choices and `policies/` holds low-frequency desired GitHub state; `plan`, `apply`, and `check` then compare the live repository.

title.zh-tw: 平台能力不足時怎麼辦
title.en: What happens when platform capability is missing

description.zh-tw: 比較假設所有方案都能強制、完全略過治理，以及明確降級並保留人工責任。
description.en: Compares assuming every plan can enforce, skipping governance entirely, and explicitly degrading while retaining a human responsibility.

csarc.zh-tw: 先查方案與 Ruleset API；不支援的能力標示 `DEGRADED` 並指定人工步驟，可修正的不一致則停止。
csarc.en: The plan and Ruleset API are probed first. Unsupported capability is marked `DEGRADED` with a human step, while fixable mismatch stops.

description.zh-tw: 比較口頭放寬、永久 bypass 與有提出者、核准者、期限、證據和復原方式的限時例外。
description.en: Compares an informal waiver, a permanent bypass, and a time-bounded exception with proposer, approver, expiry, evidence, and recovery.

csarc.zh-tw: 例外使用連結 Issue 留下五項欄位；另一位人員核准，復原驗證後才關閉，延期必須重新核准。
csarc.en: A linked Issue records all five fields; a different person approves it, recovery is verified before closure, and extensions require renewed approval.

position.zh-tw: Agent-ready repository framework：把 AI 工作規則、持久計畫、驗證與安全更新放進 repo。
position.en: An agent-ready repository framework that puts AI working rules, durable plans, verification, and safe updates in the repository.

zh-tw: Repository Harness 偏向替既有 repo 加上 agent 工作框架與安全更新機制。
CSARC 另外提供可生成的技術 profile、GitHub 治理、交付與版本政策。
en: Repository Harness primarily adds an agent working framework and safe update mechanism to an existing repository.
CSARC also supplies generated technology profiles, GitHub governance, delivery, and version policy.

description.zh-tw: repo 同時保存產品文件、決策、plan、程式與驗證證據。
description.en: The repository keeps product documents, decisions, plans, code, and verification evidence together.

description.zh-tw: 跨 session、有依賴或高風險的工作才建立 active plan；它管理執行步驟，但不另外定義 GitHub Issue Type、Parent 或里程碑。
description.en: Only cross-session, dependent, or high-risk work receives an active plan. It organizes execution steps without defining GitHub Issue Types, parents, or Milestones.

description.zh-tw: 高風險決策可設人類檢查點，但沒有要求另一位非提案者先留言同意的里程碑門檻。
description.en: High-risk decisions may use human checkpoints, but there is no Milestone gate requiring prior agreement from a non-proposer.

description.zh-tw: 保存 exact upstream base，以三方合併更新；重疊衝突時不改 managed files，保留 BASE／LOCAL／UPSTREAM 讓人 continue 或 abort。
description.en: It stores the exact upstream base and performs a three-way update. Overlapping conflicts leave managed files untouched and retain BASE, LOCAL, and UPSTREAM for a person to continue or abort.

description.zh-tw: 跨 session 工作先進 active plan，完成後才歸檔。
description.en: Work spanning sessions stays in an active plan and is archived only after completion.

description.zh-tw: 小 typo 不建 plan；高風險或長工作才增加持久文件。
description.en: A small typo needs no plan; risky or long-running work receives a durable record.

description.zh-tw: 把 agent 的固定工作規則與驗證命令保存在 repo 內。
description.en: Persistent agent working rules and verification commands live in the repository.

description.zh-tw: 跨 session、有依賴或高風險工作使用 active plan，完成後歸檔。
description.en: Cross-session, dependent, or high-risk work uses an active plan that is archived after completion.

description.zh-tw: 以獨立分支與工作目錄避免多項修改互相覆蓋。
description.en: Separate branches and working directories keep concurrent changes from overwriting one another.

description.zh-tw: 風險、方向與不可逆步驟在計畫中留下明確的人類檢查點。
description.en: Plans retain explicit human checkpoints for risk, direction, and irreversible steps.

description.zh-tw: 高風險或不可逆操作可要求人類檢查點；它沒有另訂 CSARC 的提出者、核准者、期限、證據與復原五欄。
description.en: High-risk or irreversible operations can require human checkpoints, but it does not define CSARC's five exception fields: proposer, approver, expiry, evidence, and recovery.

description.zh-tw: 本機與 Pre-Merge Contract workflow 執行同一支驗證程式，不在 YAML 重寫測試邏輯。
description.en: Local runs and the Pre-Merge Contract workflow execute the same validation script instead of rewriting test logic in YAML.

description.zh-tw: 一項 active plan 使用一條隔離分支；小改則可不建立持久 plan，避免每張 PR 都背負完整規格。
description.en: One active plan uses one isolated branch, while small changes can omit a durable plan so every PR does not carry a full specification.

description.zh-tw: 合併前以同一支本機腳本驗證必要契約；它提供證據，但不另外定義多層 delivery branch。
description.en: The same local script validates the required contract before merge. It produces evidence without defining a separate multi-layer delivery-branch model.

description.zh-tw: 以可觀察的不變條件整理 installer、workflow、文件與 release 測試；已移除的歷史能力不繼續留在現行 pre-merge。
description.en: Installer, workflow, documentation, and release tests are mapped to observable invariants; removed historical capabilities no longer stay in the current pre-merge suite.

position.zh-tw: Project generator：用一般程式語言宣告專案，持續 synth 出受管設定與工作流程。
position.en: A project generator that declares a project in a general-purpose language and continuously synthesizes managed configuration and workflows.

zh-tw: projen 把 .projenrc 當唯一來源，大量生成檔不允許直接修改。
CSARC 用 Copier 發布可更新基線，並保留產品檔案與政策檔案的責任邊界。
en: projen treats .projenrc as the only source and prevents direct edits to many generated files.
CSARC distributes an updatable Copier baseline while preserving ownership boundaries for product and policy files.

description.zh-tw: .projenrc 是唯一手寫真相，其他專案檔由 synth 產生。
description.en: .projenrc is the only hand-written source of truth; synth generates the other project files.

description.zh-tw: 先選語言／框架的 project type，再以 components 加入能力；不像 CSARC 以獨立語言勾選組合同一個 repo。
description.en: A language or framework project type establishes the base and components add capabilities; unlike CSARC, it does not compose one repository from independent language selections.

description.zh-tw: .projenrc 是單一宣告來源，synth 重建受管檔；一致性強，但手改生成檔會被覆寫。
description.en: .projenrc is the single declaration source and synth regenerates managed files. This is strongly consistent, but direct edits to generated files are overwritten.

description.zh-tw: 用 typed components 宣告期望專案，再由 synth 收斂檔案。
description.en: Typed components declare the desired project and synth reconciles the files.

description.zh-tw: 在 .projenrc 宣告 repository 與 workflow 設定後由 synth 產生檔案；平台實際是否強制仍交給 GitHub。
description.en: Repository and workflow settings are declared in .projenrc and synthesized into files, while actual platform enforcement remains GitHub's responsibility.

description.zh-tw: 可以產生 GitHub 設定與 workflow，但不以 CSARC 的 plan／apply／check 模型回報每個 repo 的方案降級。
description.en: It can generate GitHub configuration and workflows, but it does not report per-repository plan degradation through CSARC's plan/apply/check model.

description.zh-tw: 專案以程式定義；建立與升級都重新 synth 受管檔，手改會被 anti-tamper 攔下，衝突不是逐檔三方合併。
description.en: A project is defined in code. Creation and upgrades re-synthesize managed files, anti-tamper rejects manual edits, and conflicts are not resolved as per-file three-way merges.

description.zh-tw: PR 同時修改 .projenrc 與重建結果，合併後才成為正式狀態。
description.en: A PR changes .projenrc together with regenerated output; the state becomes authoritative after merge.

description.zh-tw: 把 build、test 等步驟定義成可由本機 CLI 與生成 workflow 共用的 task graph。
description.en: Build and test steps are defined as a task graph shared by the local CLI and generated workflows.

description.zh-tw: task 或 step 可用 condition 決定是否執行；適合條件分流，但條件本身仍要維護正確。
description.en: A task or step can use a condition to decide whether it runs; this supports routing but the conditions still need correct maintenance.

description.zh-tw: 在測試中 synth 專案並檢查生成檔；官方也提醒整棵樹的 snapshot 過大，應縮到有意義的輸出。
description.en: Tests synthesize a project and inspect generated files; the guide also warns that whole-tree snapshots are unwieldy and should be narrowed to meaningful output.

description.zh-tw: 由 project model 產生設定；自訂仍回到 .projenrc。
description.en: The project model generates the configuration; customization returns to .projenrc.

description.zh-tw: 由 project model 產生 PR workflows 並執行既有 tasks；是否允許合併仍交給 GitHub branch protection／Ruleset。
description.en: The project model generates PR workflows that run existing tasks, while GitHub branch protection or Rulesets still decide whether merging is allowed.

description.zh-tw: 模板可用複選答案決定產生哪些語言檔案；Copier 提供機制，但不替模板決定要用哪些測試工具。
description.en: A template can use multiselect answers to choose language files. Copier supplies the mechanism but does not choose the testing tools.

description.zh-tw: answers file 保存來源、版本與選項，可供 smart update 重用；CSARC 直接把它當唯一公版設定，避免再同步另一份 profile。
description.en: The answers file retains source, revision, and selections for smart updates. CSARC also uses it as the sole template configuration so no second profile can drift.

description.zh-tw: answers 與 Jinja 宣告生成輸入，但不持續控制遠端狀態。
description.en: Answers and Jinja templates declare generation inputs without continuously controlling remote state.

description.zh-tw: answers file 保存來源與上次答案；update 以三方差異套新版，inline marker 或 .rej 衝突由人處理。CSARC 再包一層 candidate-first，未通過前不改 target。
description.en: The answers file retains the source and prior answers. Update applies a three-way diff, leaving inline markers or .rej conflicts for a person. CSARC adds a candidate-first wrapper so the target is unchanged until verification passes.

description.zh-tw: 更新先產生 Git diff，解衝突並合併後才接受。
description.en: An update first produces a Git diff and is accepted only after conflicts are resolved and the change is merged.

position.zh-tw: Developer portal framework：以 Software Catalog、Software Templates 與 TechDocs 統一軟體生態系入口。
position.en: A developer portal framework that unifies a software ecosystem through Software Catalog, Software Templates, and TechDocs.

zh-tw: Backstage 是需要持續維運的中央 portal，強項是服務探索、owner 與 scaffolding。
CSARC 是可攜的 repo-local 公版，直接把治理、驗證與交付基線放進每個 repo。
en: Backstage is a centrally operated portal focused on service discovery, ownership, and scaffolding.
CSARC is a portable repository-local baseline that places governance, verification, and delivery in each repository.

description.zh-tw: Catalog entity 保存服務、owner 與關係的中央真相。
description.en: Catalog entities provide a central source of truth for services, owners, and relationships.

description.zh-tw: 建立元件時可詢問語言／框架並條件式執行步驟，適合入口網站；既有 repo 仍要另接更新機制。
description.en: Component creation can ask for a language or framework and run conditional steps, which suits a portal; existing repositories still need a separate update mechanism.

description.zh-tw: YAML entity 與 Software Template 宣告 portal 中的元件和建立流程。
description.en: YAML entities and Software Templates declare portal components and creation workflows.

description.zh-tw: 權限政策在中央 Backstage backend 評估，適合 portal；不像 CSARC 將可攜政策與期望 GitHub 狀態保存在每個 repo。
description.en: Permission policy is evaluated by the central Backstage backend, which suits a portal; unlike CSARC, it does not keep portable policy and desired GitHub state in each repository.

description.zh-tw: 權限框架回傳授權決策，但不負責偵測 GitHub 方案是否能建立 Ruleset；repo 門禁仍需另接 GitHub 設定。
description.en: The framework returns authorization decisions but does not detect whether a GitHub plan can create a Ruleset; repository merge gates still need separate GitHub configuration.

description.zh-tw: 擅長建立新元件；既有 repo 遷移仍要另接工具。
description.en: It excels at creating new components; existing-repository migration still needs another tool.

position.zh-tw: Software supply chain security platform：集中評估 repository 與 artifact，並依 policy 告警或修正。
position.en: A software supply-chain security platform that centrally evaluates repositories and artifacts and alerts or remediates according to policy.

zh-tw: Minder 專注中央安全姿態與持續 policy enforcement，需要常駐服務。
CSARC 涵蓋完整 repo 開發生命週期，目前以可攜政策與本機驗證為基線。
en: Minder focuses on centralized security posture and continuous policy enforcement and requires an operating service.
CSARC spans the repository development lifecycle and currently uses portable policy plus local verification as its baseline.

description.zh-tw: Profile 宣告安全期望，服務持續評估並可自動修正。
description.en: Profiles declare security expectations; the service continuously evaluates them and can remediate findings.

description.zh-tw: Profile 在中央服務宣告 repository 與 artifact 規則，再持續評估綁定的 repo。
description.en: Profiles declare repository and artifact rules in a central service, which continuously evaluates bound repositories.

description.zh-tw: 規則評估輸出成功、失敗或錯誤並可接 remediation；需要常駐服務，不是 repo-local 的 GitHub 方案降級。
description.en: Rule evaluation reports success, failure, or error and can connect remediation. It requires an operating service rather than repository-local GitHub-plan degradation.

position.zh-tw: Spec-driven development toolkit：讓任何 AI coding agent 依 spec、plan 與 tasks 交付軟體。
position.en: A spec-driven development toolkit for delivering software through specs, plans, and tasks with any AI coding agent.

zh-tw: Spec Kit 集中在需求澄清、規格拆解與 agent 實作流程。
CSARC 另外涵蓋 repo profile、治理、供應鏈、版本交付與模板更新。
en: Spec Kit concentrates on requirement clarification, specification decomposition, and agent implementation workflows.
CSARC also covers repository profiles, governance, supply chain, version delivery, and template updates.

description.zh-tw: spec、plan、tasks 與 constitution 在 repo 形成 feature 脈絡。
description.en: A spec, plan, tasks, and constitution form the feature context inside the repository.

description.zh-tw: 一個 feature 依序拆成規格、計畫與 tasks；適合大型功能，但不是 GitHub 原生 Parent、Dependency 與里程碑模型。
description.en: A feature is decomposed into a specification, plan, and tasks. This suits substantial features but is not GitHub's native parent, dependency, and Milestone model.

description.zh-tw: artifacts 在 feature branch 演進，最後仍交給 Git／PR 接受。
description.en: Artifacts evolve on a feature branch and are ultimately accepted through Git and a PR.

description.zh-tw: 完整流程最適合大型 feature，小修可走較短路徑。
description.en: The full workflow suits substantial features, while small fixes can follow a shorter path.

description.zh-tw: constitution 保存跨功能都要遵守的原則，agent 產生後續 artifacts 時會引用。
description.en: A constitution stores principles that every feature follows and agents reference while producing later artifacts.

description.zh-tw: 把需求、技術計畫與工作拆解保存成可跨 session 接力的檔案。
description.en: Requirements, technical plans, and task breakdowns are saved as files that survive across sessions.

description.zh-tw: 每個 feature 在自己的分支與規格目錄演進，降低平行修改碰撞。
description.en: Each feature evolves on its own branch and specification directory, reducing collisions between parallel changes.

description.zh-tw: 在規格不明或跨 artifact 不一致時先澄清，再交給 agent 產生計畫。
description.en: Ambiguity and cross-artifact inconsistencies are clarified before an agent generates the plan.

description.zh-tw: 實作前以唯讀分析核對 spec、plan、tasks 與 constitution；它證明規格一致，不取代程式測試。
description.en: A read-only pre-implementation analysis checks the spec, plan, tasks, and constitution; it proves artifact consistency, not program correctness.

position.zh-tw: Spec framework：用 current specs 與 change proposals 管理 AI 輔助開發中的需求變更。
position.en: A specification framework that manages requirement changes in AI-assisted development through current specs and change proposals.

zh-tw: OpenSpec 專注規格從 propose、apply 到 archive 的生命週期。
CSARC 把同類工作邊界接到 Issue、PR、治理、交付與可更新 repo 公版。
en: OpenSpec focuses on the propose, apply, and archive lifecycle of specifications.
CSARC connects that work boundary to Issues, PRs, governance, delivery, and an updatable repository baseline.

description.zh-tw: specs 保存 current truth，changes 保存尚未接受的 delta。
description.en: Specs preserve current truth, while changes hold deltas that have not yet been accepted.

description.zh-tw: change proposal 可先審查再 apply，但不提供里程碑的獨立同意與反駁門檻。
description.en: A change proposal may be reviewed before apply, but it does not provide an independent agreement and objection gate for a Milestone.

description.zh-tw: propose → apply → archive 後，才把內容併回正式規格。
description.en: Only after propose, apply, and archive does the content merge into the authoritative specification.

description.zh-tw: 小修改可直接走 PR，大變更才建立完整 proposal。
description.en: Small edits can go directly through a PR; substantial changes receive a complete proposal.

description.zh-tw: repo 內的 OpenSpec 結構與命令讓不同 agent 依同一 change lifecycle 工作。
description.en: The repository's OpenSpec structure and commands give different agents one shared change lifecycle.

description.zh-tw: proposal、design、tasks 與規格差異保存在 changes/，完成後再歸檔。
description.en: Proposals, designs, tasks, and specification deltas stay in changes/ and are archived after completion.

description.zh-tw: change proposal 先由人審查意圖與差異，接受後才 apply 與 archive。
description.en: People review a change proposal's intent and delta before it is applied and archived.

description.zh-tw: 在歸檔前逐項核對 change artifacts、tasks 與實作，並把未驗證或不一致處明確列出。
description.en: Before archiving, it checks change artifacts, tasks, and implementation and explicitly reports anything unverified or inconsistent.

position.zh-tw: AI-driven agile delivery method：以多角色工作流程與依複雜度調整的規劃推進產品。
position.en: An AI-driven agile delivery method that advances products through multi-role workflows and complexity-adjusted planning.

zh-tw: BMAD 提供完整方法、agent 角色與分級規劃流程。
CSARC 不綁 agent persona，重點是可執行、可更新的 repository 基線。
en: BMAD provides a complete method, agent roles, and tiered planning workflows.
CSARC does not prescribe agent personas; it focuses on an executable and updatable repository baseline.

description.zh-tw: brief、spec、architecture 依複雜度累積成持久工作脈絡。
description.en: Briefs, specifications, and architecture records accumulate durable context according to complexity.

description.zh-tw: artifacts 在 clarify → plan → build／verify 之間逐步成熟。
description.en: Artifacts mature through clarify, plan, build, and verify.

description.zh-tw: Quick Flow 處理小改，複雜產品才加完整 planning 與 architecture。
description.en: Quick Flow handles small changes; complex products add full planning and architecture.

description.zh-tw: 以產品、架構、開發與 QA 等角色提示，為每個階段提供專門指令。
description.en: Product, architecture, development, and QA roles provide specialized instructions for each phase.

description.zh-tw: brief、PRD、UX、architecture 與 stories 讓多角色 agent 跨階段接力。
description.en: Briefs, PRDs, UX, architecture, and stories let multiple agent roles hand work across phases.

description.zh-tw: 依工作規模在 discovery、規劃與交付階段加入人類確認點。
description.en: Human confirmation points are added during discovery, planning, and delivery according to work size.

description.zh-tw: 交付前依使用情境檢查完成的功能，讓驗收回到實際行為而不是只看工作狀態。
description.en: Completed work is exercised through usage scenarios before delivery, keeping acceptance tied to behavior instead of task status alone.

description.zh-tw: Recipe 宣告 semantic transformation，再由 parser／visitor 套用。
description.en: A Recipe declares a semantic transformation that parsers and visitors apply.

description.zh-tw: 不用文字模板覆蓋檔案，而是直接執行跨版本語意遷移。
description.en: Instead of overwriting files from a text template, it performs semantic migration across versions.

position.zh-tw: Agent skills framework：用可組合 skills 固定從釐清、規劃、實作到審查的開發方法。
position.en: An agent-skills framework that standardizes clarification, planning, implementation, and review with composable skills.

zh-tw: Superpowers 定義 agent 如何執行軟體工作的技能與節奏。
CSARC 定義 repo 應保存的契約、驗證、治理與升級機制，不把技能框架列為相依。
en: Superpowers defines the skills and cadence an agent uses to execute software work.
CSARC defines the contracts, verification, governance, and upgrade mechanisms a repository retains without depending on a skills framework.

description.zh-tw: 把已確認的設計與實作計畫寫進 repo，再依計畫逐項執行。
description.en: Confirmed designs and implementation plans are written into the repository and then executed step by step.

description.zh-tw: 完成驗證後，明確選擇 PR、合併、保留或捨棄分支。
description.en: After verification, the workflow explicitly chooses a PR, merge, retained branch, or discarded work.

description.zh-tw: 依任務需要啟用 brainstorming、planning、TDD 或 review，不把每個步驟硬套到所有工作。
description.en: Brainstorming, planning, TDD, and review skills are activated as needed instead of forcing every step onto every task.

description.zh-tw: 以可組合技能提供 agent 可重複執行的工作方法。
description.en: Composable skills give agents repeatable working methods.

description.zh-tw: 將設計、步驟、檔案與驗證寫成計畫，讓後續 session 可接續。
description.en: Designs, steps, files, and checks are written into plans that later sessions can continue.

description.zh-tw: 使用 Git worktree 建立隔離工作區，再把獨立任務交給不同 agent。
description.en: Git worktrees create isolated workspaces before independent tasks are assigned to different agents.

description.zh-tw: 先逐段確認設計，再開始撰寫計畫與實作。
description.en: Design sections are confirmed before planning and implementation begin.

description.zh-tw: 宣稱完成前必須重新執行能證明該主張的完整命令、讀完輸出並確認 exit code。
description.en: Before claiming completion, it requires rerunning the complete command that proves the claim, reading its output, and checking the exit code.

description.zh-tw: 測試通過後才讓人明確選擇 merge、PR、保留或捨棄分支；它是 agent 工作步驟，不是 GitHub 強制門禁。
description.en: After tests pass, a person explicitly chooses merge, PR, retain, or discard. This is an agent workflow step, not an enforced GitHub gate.

position.zh-tw: Open format：用 repo 內的 Markdown 為 coding agents 提供指令。
position.en: An open format for giving coding agents instructions through Markdown inside a repository.

zh-tw: AGENTS.md 只定義 agent 指令的可攜入口，不管理工作、驗證或治理。
CSARC 採用這個格式，但另外規範 Issue／PR、worktree、測試與權限。
en: AGENTS.md defines only a portable instruction entrypoint and does not manage work, verification, or governance.
CSARC adopts the format and separately defines Issues, PRs, worktrees, tests, and permissions.

description.zh-tw: 一般 Markdown 放在 repo 中，agent 可依目錄層級讀取就近規範。
description.en: Ordinary Markdown lives in the repository and agents can read instructions scoped by directory.

position.zh-tw: Agent rules distributor：從中央規則產生多種 coding agent 的設定檔。
position.en: An agent-rules distributor that emits configuration files for multiple coding agents from central rules.

zh-tw: Ruler 解決多種 agent 各自格式不同的同步問題。
CSARC 直接選 AGENTS.md 為唯一來源，不先增加轉換層。
en: Ruler synchronizes different rule-file formats used by multiple agents.
CSARC chooses AGENTS.md as the single source and does not add a conversion layer yet.

description.zh-tw: 集中維護規則，再輸出到各 agent 專用設定檔。
description.en: Rules are maintained centrally and emitted into agent-specific configuration files.

position.zh-tw: Git-native task manager：把 backlog、狀態與決策留在 repo 內供人與 agent 共用。
position.en: A Git-native task manager that keeps backlog, state, and decisions in the repository for people and agents.

zh-tw: Backlog.md 以 Markdown 檔案取代外部工作追蹤器。
CSARC 以 GitHub Issue／PR 作為日常狀態，repo 文件只保存長期契約。
en: Backlog.md uses Markdown files instead of an external work tracker.
CSARC uses GitHub Issues and PRs for daily state and keeps only durable contracts in repository documents.

description.zh-tw: 任務、狀態與決策以 Markdown 留在 Git history。
description.en: Tasks, status, and decisions remain as Markdown in Git history.

description.zh-tw: 任務檔隨分支與 PR 變更，合併後成為團隊共享狀態。
description.en: Task files change with branches and PRs and become shared state after merge.

description.zh-tw: 以狀態、優先度與父子工作管理任務；資料保存在 Markdown，而不是 GitHub 原生 Issue 與里程碑。
description.en: Status, priority, and parent-child relationships organize tasks in Markdown rather than native GitHub Issues and Milestones.

description.zh-tw: agent 可直接讀寫版本化任務檔，在 session 之間保留脈絡。
description.en: Agents can read and write versioned task files that preserve context across sessions.

position.zh-tw: Monorepo build platform：用 project graph、task graph 與遠端快取縮小並加速本機及 CI 工作。
position.en: A monorepo build platform that uses project and task graphs plus remote caching to reduce and accelerate local and CI work.

zh-tw: Nx 的 affected 計算建立在 monorepo project graph，適合大量互相依賴的專案。
CSARC 面向單一 repo 公版，先以路徑與交付階段分級，不要求導入 Nx runtime。
en: Nx computes affected work from a monorepo project graph and suits many interdependent projects.
CSARC targets a single-repository baseline and first routes by paths and delivery stage without requiring the Nx runtime.

description.zh-tw: 比較 Git base／head 與 project graph，只執行受變更影響的 tasks。
description.en: It compares the Git base and head against the project graph and runs only tasks affected by the change.

description.zh-tw: plugin 從各專案設定推導 build／test 任務並放進同一張 project graph；適合大型 workspace，但需要 Nx runtime。
description.en: Plugins infer build and test tasks from project settings and place them in one project graph. This suits large workspaces but requires the Nx runtime.

position.zh-tw: 可程式化 pipeline engine：同一套容器化 pipeline 可在本機、CI 或雲端執行。
position.en: A programmable pipeline engine whose containerized pipeline runs locally, in CI, or in the cloud.

zh-tw: Dagger 以 SDK、容器與 cache graph 提供跨 CI 平台一致的執行環境。
CSARC 只要求可直接執行的 repo-local scripts，避免所有採用者先承擔額外 pipeline runtime。
en: Dagger uses SDKs, containers, and a cache graph for consistent execution across CI providers.
CSARC requires directly runnable repository-local scripts so adopters do not first need another pipeline runtime.

description.zh-tw: 同一支 pipeline function 可在開發機與不同 CI provider 執行；換來的是 Dagger engine 與容器依賴。
description.en: The same pipeline function runs on a developer machine and across CI providers, at the cost of a Dagger engine and container dependency.

position.zh-tw: Git branch workflow CLI：在既有 Git hosting 上管理 feature branches、stack、同步與交付。
position.en: A Git branch workflow CLI for feature branches, stacks, synchronization, and delivery on existing Git hosting.

zh-tw: Git Town 專注於本機 branch 與 stacked changes 的操作體驗。
CSARC 另外定義 Issue／里程碑路由、驗證證據與 GitHub 治理；目前不要求安裝額外 Git CLI。
en: Git Town focuses on the local branch and stacked-change workflow.
CSARC also defines Issue and Milestone routing, verification evidence, and GitHub governance without requiring another Git CLI.

description.zh-tw: 每條 feature branch 可基於前一條分支形成 stack，讓相依改動仍拆成較小的 PR。
description.en: Each feature branch can build on the previous branch in a stack, keeping dependent changes in smaller PRs.

description.zh-tw: 把 main、parent 與 child branches 依 lineage 更新，衝突停在本機交由作者處理。
description.en: It updates main, parent, and child branches along their lineage and stops for the author to resolve local conflicts.

position.zh-tw: 可擴展版本控制系統：以 commit stack 與 GitHub 整合處理大型 repo 的開發與審查。
position.en: A scalable version-control system using commit stacks and GitHub integration for development and review in large repositories.

zh-tw: Sapling 以新的 VCS 操作模型與 stacked commits 改善大型 repo 工作。
CSARC 保留一般 Git／GitHub 操作，只規範 PR 路由、證據與交付邊界。
en: Sapling introduces a VCS workflow and stacked commits for large repositories.
CSARC keeps ordinary Git and GitHub workflows and defines only PR routing, evidence, and delivery boundaries.

description.zh-tw: 把相依工作保存為一串可 individually review 的 commits，不必先壓成一個大型變更。
description.en: Dependent work remains a stack of individually reviewable commits instead of one large squashed change.

description.zh-tw: 將 stack 對應為 GitHub PR 並更新相依關係；適合深度堆疊，但需要 Sapling 工作模型。
description.en: It maps a stack to GitHub pull requests and updates their dependencies, which suits deep stacks but requires the Sapling workflow.

position.zh-tw: GitHub 原生依賴更新服務：依 repo 設定提出版本與安全更新 PR。
position.en: GitHub-native dependency update service that opens version and security update PRs from repository configuration.

zh-tw: Dependabot 專注於發現並提出套件更新。
CSARC 以它作為更新入口，另由鎖檔、OSV 與 SBOM 處理安裝、漏洞與成品證據。
en: Dependabot focuses on discovering and proposing package updates.
CSARC uses it as the update entrypoint and handles installation, vulnerabilities, and artifact evidence with lockfiles, OSV, and SBOMs.

description.zh-tw: 依 ecosystem、分組與 cooldown 提出 PR；安全更新不等待。
description.en: Opens PRs by ecosystem, group, and cooldown; security updates do not wait.

description.zh-tw: 依 advisory 提出最小安全更新 PR；不取代完整掃描。
description.en: Opens a minimal security PR from an advisory; it does not replace a complete scan.

position.zh-tw: 可高度客製的依賴更新平台：以 presets 與 packageRules 集中控制更新行為。
position.en: A highly configurable dependency update platform using presets and packageRules to centralize update behavior.

zh-tw: Renovate 的跨 repo preset、分組與時程控制比 Dependabot 細。
CSARC 目前優先採 GitHub 原生身分；直到確有跨 repo 規則缺口才承擔 App 權限與維運成本。
en: Renovate offers finer cross-repository presets, grouping, and scheduling than Dependabot.
CSARC currently prefers GitHub's native identity and accepts App permissions and operational cost only when a real fleet-policy gap appears.

description.zh-tw: 共用 preset 可依套件、版本型態與年齡分組或延後。
description.en: Shared presets group or delay updates by package, version type, and age.

position.zh-tw: Python 專案與套件管理器：管理 Python 版本、環境、lockfile、執行命令與建置。
position.en: A Python project and package manager for Python versions, environments, lockfiles, command execution, and builds.

zh-tw: uv 專注 Python 開發與相依解析，不定義其他語言或 GitHub 工作治理。
CSARC 使用 uv 作為 Python 模組的原生入口，再與其他語言模組及共通規則組合。
en: uv focuses on Python development and dependency resolution rather than other languages or GitHub work governance.
CSARC uses uv as the native Python entrypoint and composes it with other language modules and shared rules.

description.zh-tw: 依 pyproject 與 lockfile 建立環境、執行 Python 工具並建置套件；格式、型別與測試由同為 Astral 工具鏈的 Ruff、ty，加上 pytest 負責。
description.en: Creates the environment from pyproject and its lockfile, runs Python tools, and builds packages; Ruff and ty from the same Astral toolchain handle quality and typing, while pytest runs tests.

description.zh-tw: 以 Python 標準專案資料加 uv.lock 固定環境；不保存 CSARC 的分支與治理選項。
description.en: Uses standard Python project metadata plus uv.lock for the environment; it does not store CSARC branch or governance selections.

description.zh-tw: uv.lock 保存跨平台解析結果，安裝時可拒絕鎖檔漂移。
description.en: uv.lock records cross-platform resolution and installation can reject lockfile drift.

position.zh-tw: Astral 的 Python 型別檢查器：直接理解 Python 專案環境，提供快速的型別診斷與編輯器支援。
position.en: Astral's Python type checker, providing fast type diagnostics and editor support with direct awareness of Python project environments.

zh-tw: ty 只負責 Python 型別分析，不管理測試、打包或 repository 工作流程。
CSARC 固定 ty 版本並由 uv 執行，再與 Ruff、pytest、打包及共通治理組成完整 Python 模組。
en: ty focuses on Python type analysis rather than tests, packaging, or repository workflow.
CSARC pins ty and runs it through uv, then combines it with Ruff, pytest, packaging, and shared governance.

description.zh-tw: 從 pyproject.toml 與 uv 環境讀取 Python 版本和相依，執行快速型別檢查；0.x 期間需固定版本避免診斷規則漂移。
description.en: Reads the Python version and dependencies from pyproject.toml and the uv environment for fast type checking; pinning is required during 0.x to avoid diagnostic drift.

position.zh-tw: JavaScript 套件管理器：以內容尋址儲存、lockfile 與解析政策控制實際安裝。
position.en: A JavaScript package manager controlling actual installs with content-addressed storage, a lockfile, and resolution policies.

zh-tw: pnpm 只處理 JavaScript 相依解析與安裝。
CSARC 使用它保護 TypeScript profile，並以其他工具涵蓋 Python、漏洞與發版證據。
en: pnpm handles JavaScript dependency resolution and installation only.
CSARC uses it to protect TypeScript profiles and adds separate tools for Python, vulnerabilities, and release evidence.

description.zh-tw: 以 package scripts 與 workspace 執行 TypeScript／JavaScript 生態圈原生的 build、test 與 package；不處理其他語言。
description.en: Package scripts and workspaces run native TypeScript and JavaScript build, test, and package commands; other languages are outside its scope.

description.zh-tw: 安裝時拒絕太新的版本與 publisher trust 降級。
description.en: Rejects overly new releases and publisher-trust downgrades during installation.

position.zh-tw: Rust 官方工具鏈：Cargo 統一專案描述、相依解析、測試、建置與打包，rustfmt／Clippy 負責品質檢查。
position.en: The official Rust toolchain: Cargo unifies project metadata, dependency resolution, tests, builds, and packaging, while rustfmt and Clippy check quality.

zh-tw: Rust／Cargo 完整處理單一語言，但不決定 repo 的 Issue、PR 或其他語言流程。
CSARC 固定經審查的 Rust 工具鏈，並讓它與 Python、TypeScript 及共通治理並存。
en: Rust and Cargo cover one language completely but do not define repository Issues, PRs, or other language workflows.
CSARC pins a reviewed Rust toolchain and composes it with Python, TypeScript, and shared governance.

comparisons.feature: cargo fmt / clippy / test / build / package

description.zh-tw: 同一個官方工具鏈完成格式、常見錯誤、測試、正式建置與套件驗證。
description.en: One official toolchain handles formatting, common mistakes, tests, release builds, and package verification.

description.zh-tw: 工具鏈檔固定 Rust 版本，Cargo.toml 描述套件；CSARC 再從單一公版設定決定是否產生這組檔案。
description.en: The toolchain file pins Rust and Cargo.toml describes the package; CSARC's single template configuration decides whether to generate this pair.

description.zh-tw: Cargo.lock 記錄精確相依版本，CI 使用 --locked 拒絕未更新的解析結果。
description.en: Cargo.lock records exact dependency versions and CI uses --locked to reject an unrecorded resolution.

position.zh-tw: 開源漏洞掃描器：把 lockfile、SBOM 或目錄中的套件版本對照 OSV 資料庫。
position.en: An open-source vulnerability scanner matching package versions from lockfiles, SBOMs, or directories against the OSV database.

zh-tw: OSV-Scanner 專注於已公開漏洞，不負責更新排程或建立成品清冊。
CSARC 將它放在依賴 PR、完整驗證與週期掃描的同一入口。
en: OSV-Scanner focuses on disclosed vulnerabilities rather than update scheduling or artifact inventory.
CSARC places it behind one entrypoint shared by dependency PRs, full verification, and scheduled scans.

description.zh-tw: 掃 lockfile／SBOM，沒有新版通知也能找出已知漏洞。
description.en: Scans lockfiles or SBOMs and finds vulnerabilities without a new-version notice.

position.zh-tw: SBOM 產生器：掃描容器映像、檔案系統或 archive，輸出 SPDX、CycloneDX 等格式。
position.en: An SBOM generator that scans container images, filesystems, or archives and emits SPDX, CycloneDX, and other formats.

zh-tw: Syft 產生套件清冊，不判斷更新時機或阻擋漏洞。
CSARC 用固定 Syft 版本掃真正成品，再額外驗證 root package、dependency graph、checksum 與來源綁定。
en: Syft generates package inventories without deciding update timing or blocking vulnerabilities.
CSARC scans real artifacts with a pinned Syft version and additionally validates root packages, the dependency graph, checksums, and source bindings.

description.zh-tw: 掃實際檔案、archive 或 image；發版流程再綁定版本與 digest。
description.en: Scans real files, archives, or images; the release flow then binds version and digest.

position.zh-tw: 以 Conventional Commits 維護可審查版本 PR，合併後建立 GitHub Release。
position.en: Maintains a reviewable version PR from Conventional Commits and creates a GitHub Release after merge.

zh-tw: Release Please 把版本與 CHANGELOG 變更集中在可審查 PR。
CSARC 採用這個人類核准邊界，並在同一 workflow 補上候選 SHA、成品、SBOM 與 immutable Release 驗證。
en: Release Please concentrates version and changelog changes in a reviewable PR.
CSARC adopts that human approval boundary and adds exact-candidate, artifact, SBOM, and immutable-Release verification in the same workflow.

description.zh-tw: 依 commit type 與 breaking marker 推導下一次版本影響。
description.en: Derives the next version impact from commit types and breaking markers.

description.zh-tw: 先開版本 PR 更新 CHANGELOG 與版本檔，讓人審查後再合併。
description.en: First opens a version PR that updates changelogs and version files for human review.

description.zh-tw: 版本 PR 合併後才建立 tag 與 GitHub Release；package publishing 仍要另接流程。
description.en: Creates the tag and GitHub Release only after the version PR merges; package publishing remains a separate concern.

position.zh-tw: 成功 CI 後依 commit 慣例全自動決定版本、產生 release notes 並發布。
position.en: Fully automates version selection, release notes, and publishing after successful CI from commit conventions.

zh-tw: semantic-release 可把 maintenance branch 上的修補直接交給自動發布。
CSARC 把修正合併與 patch Release 拆成兩個決策：hotfix 先 review／full verification，精確版本與 CHANGELOG 再由 Release Please PR 供人核准。
en: semantic-release can hand fixes on maintenance branches directly to automated publishing.
CSARC separates merging a fix from a patch Release: the hotfix first passes review and full verification, then a Release Please PR presents the exact version and changelog for approval.

description.zh-tw: 從 release branch 上的 commit messages 自動判斷 consumer impact。
description.en: Automatically derives consumer impact from commit messages on a release branch.

description.zh-tw: 成功 build 後在同一套自動流程分析 commits、配置版本並產生 notes。
description.en: After a successful build, one automated flow analyzes commits, materializes the version, and generates notes.

description.zh-tw: 維護分支可限制在既有 major／minor 範圍發布相容修補，CI 再由 plugins 建立 tag、Release 或 registry publish。
description.en: Maintenance branches can publish compatible fixes within an existing major or minor range before CI plugins create tags, Releases, or registry publications.

position.zh-tw: 以 changeset 檔讓 contributor 描述版本影響，特別適合多套件 monorepo。
position.en: Lets contributors describe version impact in changeset files, with a focus on multi-package monorepos.

zh-tw: Changesets 能處理互相依賴的多 package 版本與 changelog。
CSARC 是單一 template release unit，不為目前不存在的 monorepo 版本矩陣加入 Node 工具。
en: Changesets coordinates versions and changelogs across dependent packages.
CSARC is one template release unit and does not add a Node tool for a monorepo version matrix it does not have.

description.zh-tw: contributor 在 PR 中明列受影響 packages、bump 等級與人類可讀摘要。
description.en: Contributors explicitly list affected packages, bump levels, and a human-readable summary in the PR.

description.zh-tw: 集中消耗 pending changesets，更新 package versions 與 changelogs。
description.en: Consumes pending changesets together and updates package versions and changelogs.

description.zh-tw: Action 可維護 version PR，或在設定 publish command 後發布 packages。
description.en: The Action can maintain a version PR or publish packages when a publish command is configured.
